about: gent's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: gent-e1-results-out-of-order
mutants.rule: Each call's result follows the results of the calls before it (law Agent.InterruptReturnsToIdle: the transcript stays well formed).

mutants.name: gent-e1-interrupt-drops-a-result
mutants.from:
case Running as r:
		log = log.Append(Result{Id: r.Call.Id, Text: Told(stopped), Ok: false})
mutants.rule: An interrupt gives the running call the result Interrupted (law Agent.InterruptReturnsToIdle).

mutants.name: gent-e1-steps-not-counted
mutants.rule: Each ask after tool results counts a step, so --max-steps stops a model that calls tools forever (case max-steps).

mutants.name: gent-e1-tools-end-the-turn
mutants.rule: After the last result of a reply's calls the model is asked again (case tools: the second reply).

mutants.name: gent-e1-retry-with-draft
mutants.rule: A failure after the first delta never waits to ask again (law Agent.NoRetryAfterFirstDelta).

mutants.name: gent-e1-delta-drops-draft
mutants.rule: A delta adds to the draft; a cut reply keeps all that came (case cut).

mutants.name: gent-e1-scripted-cut-is-a-turn
mutants.from:
case Breaks as b:
		agent.Truncated{Text: strings.Join(b.Pieces, "")}
mutants.to:
case Breaks as b:
		agent.Turn{Text: strings.Join(b.Pieces, ""), Calls: []agent.Call{}, End: agent.Finished}
mutants.rule: A reply with no end is Truncated, never a Turn (law Model.TruncatedIsNotATurn for Scripted).

mutants.name: gent-e1-replay-loses-limits
mutants.rule: A replay folds under the limits the run started with (law ReplayIsTheRun).

mutants.name: gent-e1-tree-lets-dotdot-out
mutants.rule: A path that goes up out of the tree fails Escapes (law Tools.LeavingEscapes for Tree).

mutants.name: gent-e1-frame-too-tall
mutants.rule: A frame has exactly the window's rows (law FrameFitsWindow).

mutants.name: gent-e1-esc-ignored-while-waiting
mutants.rule: The key the status line names stops the turn in every phase, Waiting too (law EveryStateShowsItsExit).

mutants.name: gent-e1-reply-marked-as-user
mutants.rule: The model's rows and the person's look different (law KindsLookDifferent).

mutants.name: gent-e1-draw-from-key-task
mutants.rule: Only the one loop paints, and only frames of states that existed (test DrawsOnlyStatesThatExisted).

mutants.name: gent-e1-stream-doubles-a-piece
mutants.rule: The pieces a stream gives join to its Turn's text (law Model.StreamJoinsToComplete for Scripted).

mutants.name: gent-e1-tree-dir-without-slash
mutants.rule: A directory's name ends in /, so a name List gives can be read or listed (law Tools.ListedIsThere for Tree).

mutants.name: gent-e1-frame-shows-the-head
mutants.rule: The transcript sticks to its end: its last line is on screen (law TailIsVisible; the frame still fits).

mutants.name: gent-e1-one-step-too-many
mutants.rule: At most MaxSteps asks follow one message (law Agent.StepsAreBounded).

mutants.name: gent-e1-result-names-no-call
mutants.from: Log: s.Log.Append(Result{Id: r.Call.Id, Text: Text(d.Outcome), Ok: Fine(d.Outcome)})
mutants.to: Log: s.Log.Append(Result{Id: "", Text: Text(d.Outcome), Ok: Fine(d.Outcome)})
mutants.rule: A tool's result names its call (law Agent.TranscriptIsWellFormed).

mutants.name: gent-e1-never-retries
mutants.rule: A failure the model may recover from, before any delta, waits and asks again (law Agent.RetriesWait).
